# ZME Science

> ZME Science is a science communication platform dedicated to making scientific discoveries and research accessible to general audiences.

ZME Science covers a wide range of scientific topics and maintains transparent policies regarding user data and privacy. The site prioritizes user trust through clear documentation of its data protection and legal practices.

## Key Topics

- Privacy Policy
- Data Protection
- Legal
- Terms of Use
- User Agreement
- Science Communication
- Research
- User Rights

## Legal & Privacy

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.zmescience.com/privacy-policy): ZME Science privacy policy outlining data usage and protection practices
